thesis: Observation, finite resources, undecidability and identifiability impose distinct limits with different remedies.
role: Reject both omniscience and generalized resignation.

ideas.statement: Determinism does not ensure detailed prediction, resource feasibility or a universal algorithm; every limit retains its domain.
Observationally identical mechanisms require different information rather than greater intelligence; this can make simulation internally indistinguishable.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Formal-system or thermodynamic-limit theorems do not establish that every concrete finite problem is insoluble.
